gloss: giving up without recourse, accepting unfairness meekly

definitions.gloss: giving up without recourse, accepting defeat/loss meekly
definitions.explanation: Accepting an unfair or unjust situation without fighting back or seeking redress, because one feels powerless or sees no way to resolve it. Literally "crying oneself to sleep."

examples.japanese: {泣|な}き{寝入|ねい}りするしかなかった。
examples.english: I had no choice but to accept it and move on.

examples.japanese: {被害者|ひがいしゃ}が{泣|な}き{寝入|ねい}りしないように{支援|しえん}する。
examples.english: We provide support so that victims don't have to suffer in silence.

examples.japanese: {詐欺|さぎ}に{遭|あ}っても{泣|な}き{寝入|ねい}りせず、{警察|けいさつ}に{届|とど}けてください。
examples.english: Even if you fall victim to fraud, don't just accept it — report it to the police.

notes:
USAGE:
Typically used with する: {泣|な}き{寝入|ねい}りする (to give up without fighting back). Often appears in negative contexts urging people not to accept injustice passively: {泣|な}き{寝入|ねい}りしないで (don't just take it lying down).

The literal image is of crying yourself to sleep — accepting something painful because you feel there is nothing you can do about it.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {泣|な}き{寝入|ねい}りする: to give up without recourse
- {泣|な}き{寝入|ねい}りしない: to not accept it meekly
- {泣|な}き{寝入|ねい}りするしかない: to have no choice but to accept it
- {泣|な}き{寝入|ねい}りさせない: to not let someone suffer in silence
